verdict.rationale: Mesh can be driven entirely headlessly through its documented API. Machine API credentials come with configurable permissions and expiry, and the API supports synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening. Results come back through webhooks, and case review can be done through the API instead of the web app. Integration is supported by an OpenAPI schema and a Postman collection. missing for 10: no official CLI or documented CI-pipeline usage/examples, no independent or hands-on corroboration of authenticated headless runs (probe only retrieved docs/schema).
